_comment: Project-ops manifest. Fill environments/test/deploy/infra; run `harness-wf domain-compile` to populate `business`.

environments.local: harness-wf init --project-path <target-repo>  (installed via `uv tool install`; mints the orchestrator plugin into a target project. NOT `uv run` from inside a target repo — its venv may hold a stale harness-wf shim)

deploy.command: bump version in pyproject.toml + CHANGELOG.md, then: git tag vX.Y.Z && git push --tags && uv build && uv publish
deploy.update-deployed: uv tool upgrade harness-wf && harness-wf update --project-path .

references.docs/RELEASING.md: Two-plane release/update contract (tool plane vs deployed plane)
